data.content_ref: inline:The target restricts its argument to 'open-world' tasks with latent variables not captured by the checklist, but the problem context fixes the task domain as 'tasks with objectively verifiable outcomes.' The proposed hidden-dependency failure mode is only a genuine objection if those hidden variables are themselves objectively verifiable but omitted from the checklist; if they are not objectively verifiable, they fall outside the problem's scope. The target never establishes that the latent variables it relies on are of the verifiable-but-omitted kind, so its central case against the panel may not apply to the problem as stated.
